title: I wanted to like them
text: I subscribed to the Marvel Collector Corps box before they were on Amazon. I used to love receiving them each month. It seems like the items they are adding to them now just keep getting cheaper. It is a pop or two, if you're lucky, and a couple of items you can find at a dollar store. I still love my Pops, but these boxes just aren't worth it anymore.
label: negative
